component.name: Slate-To-UCS
component.summary: Label sound effects with UCS metadata

description.p: Slate-To-UCS reads a sound effect, transcribes any spoken slate, and suggests the Universal Category System metadata for it: category, subcategory, CatID, keywords and a UCS file name.
Everything runs locally. The classifier is a local model served on loopback, and offline mode is the default, so no audio, transcript or file name leaves the machine.
First packaged release: the CLI, the desktop shell and the REAPER integration.
